design_question: 能否用绝对广度质量与多日确认，在V1-B安全性和V1-C召回之间建立有限中间结构？

standard_path.condition: A AND B AND C AND D AND Enhancer

shared_contract.null_policy: NULL never counts as TRUE and never advances qualification
shared_contract.freeze_policy: Freeze pauses counters and cannot trigger a hard transition

candidates.name: Breadth-qualified weighted evidence
candidates.structure: shared prerequisites AND at_least_2(B,C,Enhancer), 2 consecutive effective days
candidates.b_role: one strong support; if B is FALSE, C and Enhancer must both be TRUE
candidates.a_role: hard core on every qualifying day
candidates.d_role: hard core plus existing above_ma20 absolute breadth floor
candidates.likely_benefit: restore persistent high-breadth cases without admitting low-base breadth expansion

candidates.name: Asymmetric B role

structure.b_present: shared prerequisites AND B AND at_least_1(C,Enhancer), 2 consecutive effective days
structure.b_waived: shared prerequisites AND NOT B AND C AND Enhancer, 3 consecutive effective days

candidates.b_role: B controls evidence and time cost rather than acting as universal veto
candidates.a_role: hard core on every qualifying day
candidates.d_role: hard core plus existing above_ma20 absolute breadth floor
candidates.persistence_role: 2 days with B, 3 days without B
candidates.likely_benefit: cover B-recovered and persistently B-weak true trends with asymmetric risk control

candidates.name: Three-day staged confirmation

structure.three_day_support: B TRUE at least once OR (B FALSE all three days AND C and Enhancer TRUE all three days)

candidates.b_role: may arrive late or be replaced by complete C+Enhancer persistence
candidates.a_role: hard core for all three qualifying days
candidates.d_role: hard core plus existing above_ma20 absolute breadth floor for all three days
candidates.persistence_role: explicit pending plus two forward validations
candidates.likely_benefit: reject two-day pulses while giving sustained evidence a second chance
candidates.main_risk: confirmation latency and pending-state implementation complexity
candidates.n08_filter: absolute breadth floor and failure to sustain A/D after the pulse

candidate_failure_guardrails: negative new confirmation exceeds 1 case or 1 transition
negative S2 exposure exceeds 11 case-industry days
any original positive event hit is lost
improvement depends on one case or one episode
matched latency, churn or negative S1 dwell guardrail fails
NULL, Freeze, future-read, legal-transition or determinism contract fails
improvement depends only on direct warmup-sensitive cases
case id, industry, event date, label or future information is used

stop_rule.candidate_failure: record failure and continue to next independent candidate without modification

winner_tiebreak_order: higher positive event recall then full-window recall
lower churn and negative S1 dwell
smaller change surface: V1-B2 then V1-B3 then V1-B4
